creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers only oil, gas and NGL exploration and production, with no creative activity, and 'state-of-the-art' is a trap term.

community.reason: Level 2: employee training programs plus a matching-gift and paid-volunteer program, with no disclosed dollars or participant numbers to show substantial reach.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1: diversity commitment, equal-opportunity language, demographic analysis and occasional pay equity testing, with no employee networks, accessibility or customer-access programs described.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 0: there are no small-business customers or enabling programs, and references to 'innovation' and 'innovative ideas' are trap terms.

evidence.activity: Leadership, talent development and technical training programs for employees
evidence.quote: During 2025, many of our employees participated in leadership and talent development programs that included industry, safety, and other specialized technical training.

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Annual charitable giving program that matches employee donations and gives paid volunteer time
evidence.quote: Our annual charitable giving program includes a monetary match of our employees’ personal contributions to qualified organizations and up to 12 hours per employee of Company-granted time to volunteer in the communities where we live and work.
evidence.indicators: up to 12 hours per employee of volunteer time

community.criterion: level 2: specific current community investment program, reach not quantified (no dollars or participants)

evidence.activity: Internal workforce demographic analyses and occasional third-party discrimination and pay equity testing
evidence.quote: We regularly perform internal analyses of our workforce demographics, and, at times, we retain a third party to conduct discrimination and pay equity testing.

cross_cultural.criterion: level 1: occasional, unquantified equal-opportunity testing alongside demographic analysis; torn between 1 and 2, so the lower level was chosen

notes: The Civitas Merger closed January 30, 2026, after fiscal year end. Most data excludes Civitas, but the 1,241 headcount includes former Civitas employees. The purpose statement and repeated 'committed to... investing in and connecting with the communities' language (Item 1 Strategy, EH&S Initiatives, Item 7) is mission language and was not scored above 1. Tribal employment and contractor preferences in the Uinta Basin are described as regulatory requirements, not company programs, so they were not counted. Item 7 refers to the proxy statement for compensation only, not for community or inclusion activities, so coverage is sufficient.
